items.en: What customs are there in your country?
Hospitality is a very important value for us.

items.uz: Bu qiziq, bizda ham shunga o'xshash an'ana bor.
items.en: That's interesting, we have a similar tradition too.

items.uz: Sizning madaniyatingiz haqida ko'proq bilishni istardim.
items.en: I would like to know more about your culture.
Of course, I'll explain everything to you.

items.uz: Hatto taomlaringiz ham juda o'ziga xos ekan.
items.en: Even your dishes turn out to be very unique.

items.uz: Faqat bitta narsani tatib ko'rsangiz ham, farqni sezasiz.
items.en: Even if you try just one thing, you'll notice the difference.

items.uz: Bu almashinuv ikkalamiz uchun ham foydali bo'ldi.
items.en: This exchange was beneficial for both of us.

items.uz: Kelajakda yana uchrashamiz, deb umid qilaman.
items.en: I hope we'll meet again in the future.
Of course, let's stay in touch.
